ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is refunded to the rider in full. The material facts are not disputed. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 14:22:40 (EV-TRIP-02754) and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02754) places him about 1.1 m from the pickup pin, stationary, at that moment — so the arrival marker is genuine, POL-NS-05 does not fire, and no false-arrival referral is recorded. What fails is the waiting period. The free wait in force for this STANDARD-zone trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the longest continuous qualifying in-geofence run in the trace is 57 seconds (14:22:40 to 14:23:37, 7 qualifying fixes), a shortfall of 123 seconds. The driver cancelled at 14:23:41, about 61 seconds after arriving. POL-NS-01 limb (c) therefore fails, and under POL-NS-06 an effective dwell shorter than the free waiting period makes the fee not chargeable whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded. That is strict liability, so the full SGD 4.50 shown charged on EV-FARE-02754 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is returned; the contested amount is SGD 4.50. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider — her device track (EV-GPS-02754) shows her within about 7.4 m of the pin across the waiting window, and her 'coming out now' message at 14:23:40 (EV-CHAT-02754) drew no reply within 120 seconds and no in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) — though the refund does not depend on that. On the driver's counterparty statement asking the tribunal to check the rider's profile for a 'history of no-shows': that is reputation reasoning, which POL-GEN-01 forbids, as no profile field may establish a fact about this trip. The only field the no-show category permits for an adverse finding against a rider is rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which reads 1, below the threshold of 3 in POL-NS-09(d); the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags may not be substituted for it. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip either — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and the rate against 58 completed trips in 30 days is 0.017 (below 0.08) — so nothing turns on the driver's record. The two claims that sought to rely on the MISSING traffic advisory were discarded by the referee for not disclosing its issue code, and in any event POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation limb is unavailable and there is only one in-geofence run, so the 57-second dwell stands on its own. The evidence is clean — 100% GPS coverage, no gaps, causally ordered trip record matching timestamps, and a fare line that reconciles to the SGD 4.50 fee — so there is no impairment under POL-NS-08 and the ruling rests on these artifacts at full weight. Confidence 0.95, above the 0.70 escalation floor. The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is at or below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold, so the refund executes on issue, subject to either party's right of appeal.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
